description: ERECTION OF A GROUND FLOOR REAR AND SIDE EXTENSION,  FIRST FLOOR REAR EXTENSION, SECOND FLOOR  MANSARD EXTENSION AND ASSOCIATED WORKS
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The siting, scale, form, and massing of the proposed second-floor roof extension would appear overly dominant and would compromise the legibility of the original hipped roof profile. As a result, it would harm the character of the original dwelling, which is a Locally Listed Building, and the wider Conservation Area. There are no identified public benefits that would outweigh this harm. Therefore, the proposal would be contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF), London Plan Policy HC1, and MLP Policy D12.5, due to the adverse impact on the significance of both the Conservation Area and the Locally Listed Building.

Reason : 2 - The siting, scale, form, and massing of the proposed second-floor roof extension would appear overly dominant and would compromise the legibility of the original hipped roof profile. Therefore the proposal would harm the character and appearance of the host dwelling and the surrounding area contrary to MLP policy D12.3 and D12.4.

Reason : 3 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the NPPF, The London Borough of Merton  (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to development proposals focused on solutions. LBM works with applicants/agents in a positive and proactive manner by:
"	Offering a pre-application advice and duty desk service. 
"	Where possible, suggesting solutions to secure a successful outcome.
"	As appropriate, updating applicants/agents of any issues that may arise in the processing of their application.
In this instance:
"	The application was not considered to comply with the provisions of the Development Plan and NPPF as submitted, and would have required substantial changes such that a new application would be required. 

"	The application was considered to be fundamentally contrary to the provisions of the Development Plan and the NPPF, and there were not considered to be any solutions to resolve this conflict.
